value.rationale: The smallest nontrivial fiber saturates the recent two-component bound but can exhibit sharply divergent or bounded Riesz projection norms under a closing spectral gap. The mean Fourier coefficient gives a natural exact criterion for stable splitting, also governing a distinct and precisely quantified Jordan-type power-growth phenomenon at collision.
